title: First Valid N-Queens Placement

monster.name: Matriarch Queen
monster.title: Ruler of Non-Attacking Diagonals
monster.defeatQuote: First non-attacking queen column vector located!

description: Given integer `n`, return the first valid placement of `n` non-attacking queens on an `n x n` board as an array of column indices for each row `0` through `n-1`, or `[]` if none exists.
solutionCode:
def firstNQueens(n: int) -> list[int]:
    cols = set()
    diag1 = set()
    diag2 = set()
    board = [-1] * n
    def backtrack(r):
        if r == n: return True
        for c in range(n):
            if c not in cols and (r - c) not in diag1 and (r + c) not in diag2:
                cols.add(c)
                diag1.add(r - c)
                diag2.add(r + c)
                board[r] = c
                if backtrack(r + 1): return True
                cols.remove(c)
                diag1.remove(r - c)
                diag2.remove(r + c)
        return False
    if backtrack(0): return board
    return []
